original_excerpt: To address this gap, this study develops AIgnite, an AI literacy toolkit for upper primary school students in Grades 4–6. … The toolkit combines AI knowledge cards with two stages supported by these cards: (i) the Board Game stage and (ii) the AI Storydrawing stage. … Developed using a child-centered approach, the toolkit underwent multiple rounds of participatory co-creation and iterative prototyping with 30 participants. … A user study with another 42 participants demonstrated the toolkit’s effectiveness in conveying AI concepts and applications and in fostering ethical reflection.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的教具對象、組成與設計過程，以及使用者研究的人數；設計本位研究，作者所述成效不寫入。

original_excerpt: This study examines the psychological mechanisms underlying Chinese K–12 teachers’ discontinuance intention towards generative AI. … Drawing on the Cognition–Affect–Conation (CAC) framework, it investigates how cognitive evaluations of generative AI relate to affective responses and subsequent behavioural intention. … A quantitative cross‐sectional survey using nonprobability convenience sampling yielded data from 256 Chinese K–12 teachers with prior experience using generative AI in teaching. … The data were analysed using structural equation modelling (SEM) and fuzzy‐set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA).
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究問題、框架、抽樣與分析方法；橫斷面相關研究，變項關聯結果不寫入。
scope_limitation: 期刊論文（Advances in Human-Computer Interaction，Wiley 開放取用期刊，不在監測清單，管理者 2026-10-20 同意收錄）；中國中小學在職教師 256 人（國小 90、國中 88、高中 78），非機率便利抽樣、橫斷面問卷，結果不宜推論；首發日依 Crossref 上線日。

summary_evidence_spans: This study examines the psychological mechanisms underlying Chinese K–12 teachers’ discontinuance intention towards generative AI.
Drawing on the Cognition–Affect–Conation (CAC) framework, it investigates how cognitive evaluations of generative AI relate to affective responses and subsequent behavioural intention.
A quantitative cross‐sectional survey using nonprobability convenience sampling yielded data from 256 Chinese K–12 teachers with prior experience using generative AI in teaching.
The data were analysed using structural equation modelling (SEM) and fuzzy‐set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA).
attributed_summary: 量化橫斷面問卷研究以認知—情感—意動（CAC）框架，探討中國中小學教師停止使用生成式 AI 的意圖背後的心理機制；以非機率便利抽樣蒐集 256 名曾在教學中使用生成式 AI 的教師資料，並採用結構方程模型（SEM）與模糊集合質性比較分析（fsQCA）。
